package handlers

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"
	"net/http"
)

// SetCompletionPolicy authors future revisions; assigned snapshots are immutable.
func (h LessonHandler) SetCompletionPolicy(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	var input struct {
		Activities []domain.LessonActivity `json:"activities"`
	}
	decoder := json.NewDecoder(http.MaxBytesReader(w, r.Body, 64<<10))
	decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
	if err := decoder.Decode(&input); err != nil {
		http.Error(w, "invalid completion policy", http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	err := h.RevisionsUC.SetPolicy(r.Context(), chi.URLParam(r, "lessonID"), input.Activities)
	if err != nil {
		status := http.StatusInternalServerError
		if errors.Is(err, domain.ErrValidation) {
			status = http.StatusUnprocessableEntity
		}
		if errors.Is(err, domain.ErrNotFound) {
			status = http.StatusNotFound
		}
		http.Error(w, http.StatusText(status), status)
		return
	}
	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusNoContent)
}
